item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-71194: In OpenStack Designate before 22.0.2, the mDNS handler performs pool-blind looku...
item.description: In OpenStack Designate before 22.0.2, the mDNS handler performs pool-blind lookups when resolving record queries and NOTIFY requests. When two zones with the same name exist across different pools, the lookup fails with a deterministic error, causing the handler to return REFUSED for all DNS queries through that path. The _handle_notify path is exploitable via a single unauthenticated UDP packet.
